dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam! It's Hannah. We met at the networking event last week.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! ɪts ˈhænə. wiː ˈmɛt ət ðə ˈnɛtwɜːrkɪŋ ɪˈvɛnt ˈlæst ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hannah! Hi! It's great to hear from you.
dialogue.reading: ˈhænə! ˈhaɪ! ɪts ˈɡreɪt tə ˈhɪr frəm juː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Listen, I talked to my friend Grace, who runs the language school.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɪsən, aɪ ˈtɔːkt tə maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈɡreɪs, huː ˈrʌnz ðə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˌskuːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, really? What did she say?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈriːli? ˈwʌt dɪd ʃiː ˈseɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She'd love to meet you. Feel free to call her any time. I'll send you her number.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːd ˈlʌv tə ˈmiːt juː. ˈfiːl ˈfriː tə ˈkɔːl hɜːr ˈɛni ˈtaɪm. aɪl ˈsɛnd juː hɜːr ˈnʌmbər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much! By the way, how do you know her?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː soʊ ˈmʌtʃ! ˈbaɪ ðə ˈweɪ, ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈnoʊ hɜːr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Through a mutual friend, actually. Do you know Mr. Brown? He teaches at your university.
dialogue.reading: θruː ə ˈmjuːtʃuəl ˈfrɛnd, ˈæktʃuəli. duː juː ˈnoʊ ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn? hiː ˈtiːtʃɪz ət jʊr ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown? He was my teacher! I can't believe it!
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn? hiː wʌz maɪ ˈtiːtʃər! aɪ ˈkænt bɪˈliːv ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Well, maybe "friend" is too strong. He's more of an acquaintance. We met at a party once.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ˈmeɪbi ˈfrɛnd ɪz ˈtuː ˈstrɔːŋ. hiːz ˈmɔːr əv ən əˈkweɪntəns. wiː ˈmɛt ət ə ˈpɑːrti ˈwʌns.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Can I ask a favor? Could you tell Grace a little about me before I call her?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈæsk ə ˈfeɪvər? kʊd juː ˈtɛl ˈɡreɪs ə ˈlɪtəl əˈbaʊt miː bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈkɔːl hɜːr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Of course. And don't hesitate to ask if you need anything else.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ənd ˈdoʊnt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tu ˈæsk ɪf juː ˈniːd ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Hannah. Maybe one day we could work together!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː, ˈhænə. ˈmeɪbi ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ wiː kʊd ˈwɜːrk təˈɡɛðər!
